title: How Much Does AppsFlyer Cost for a Small Subscription App? — Airbridge

facts.fact: AppsFlyer's Growth plan charges $0.07 per attributed conversion after the Welcome Package is used up (AppsFlyer's published rate, as reported by Airbridge).
facts.quote: AppsFlyer's Growth plan charges $0.07 per attributed conversion after a Welcome Package of 12,000 free conversions in the first 12 months.

facts.fact: AppsFlyer's Welcome Package includes 12,000 free conversions to use within the first 12 months.
facts.quote: Includes the Welcome Package: 12,000 free conversions to use within the first 12 months

facts.fact: Under AppsFlyer's Growth plan, a subscription app with 10,000 attributed conversions a month would pay about $700 a month after the Welcome Package, before add-ons.
facts.quote: A subscription app with 10,000 attributed conversions a month would pay about $700 a month once the Welcome Package is used up

facts.fact: Airbridge's table lists AppsFlyer Growth cost at 5,000 monthly attributed conversions as $350/mo, a figure derived from AppsFlyer's $0.07 rate.
Under AppsFlyer's Growth plan, organic installs are not counted and are free.
facts.quote: Organic installs are not counted and are free

facts.fact: AppsFlyer's Growth plan sells Protect360, Data Locker, Audiences, API access, and ROI360 separately as premium products.
facts.quote: Premium products such as Protect360, Data Locker, Audiences, API access, and ROI360 are sold separately

facts.fact: AppsFlyer's Welcome Package includes a 30-day trial of select premium add-ons.
facts.quote: The Welcome Package includes a 30-day trial of select premium add-ons

facts.fact: AppsFlyer describes its free Zero plan as not suitable for apps with paid activities.
facts.quote: "not suitable for apps with paid activities"

facts.fact: In AppsFlyer's billing, a conversion is an attributed install, re-engagement, or re-attribution.
facts.quote: A conversion is an attributed install, [re-engagement](https://www.airbridge.io/en/glossary/re-engagement "Re-engagement"), or re-attribution

facts.fact: Airbridge's Core Plan is $40+ per month after a 30-day free trial (Airbridge's own pricing claim).
facts.quote: Airbridge's Core Plan is $40+/mo after a 30-day free trial

facts.fact: Airbridge's Core Plan includes 500K data points per month.
Airbridge's Core Plan charges $0.0001 per data point beyond the included usage (Airbridge's own pricing).
Airbridge states that a month with 1M data points on its Core Plan costs $90.
facts.quote: a month with 1M data points costs $40 + (500K × $0.0001) = $90

facts.fact: Airbridge defines a data point as one event collected for an app, such as installs, app opens, trial starts, or purchases; tracking-link clicks and ad impressions do not count.
facts.quote: Tracking-link clicks and ad impressions do not count.

facts.fact: Airbridge's Core Plan has no annual contract and can be cancelled anytime (Airbridge's own claim).
Airbridge's Core Plan includes a 30-day free trial with no data point limits.
facts.quote: 30-day free trial, no data point limits

facts.fact: Airbridge's Core Plan includes Predictive LTV covering 180 days without an add-on.
Airbridge's blog states that several MMPs, including Singular, Kochava, and Adjust, offer free tiers (a third-party-style claim made by Airbridge).
facts.quote: Several MMPs offer free tiers, including Singular, Kochava, and Adjust.
